'''Jiang Long''' ({{zh|s=江龙}}; 1 January 1933 – 31 December 2022) was a Chinese physical chemist, and an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]]. He was a member of the [[Chinese Communist Party]] (CCP).<ref>{{cite news |url=http://www.ic.cas.cn/xwzx/swdt/200307/t20030706_239524.html |script-title=zh:化学所表彰一批先进党支部、优秀共产党员和优秀党务工作者 |work=ic.cas.cn |date=6 July 2003 |access-date=2 January 2023 |language=zh}}</ref>

==Biography==
Jiang was born in [[Shanghai]], on 1 January 1933, while his [[Ancestral home (Chinese)|ancestral home]] is in [[Jian'ou]], [[Fujian]].<ref name="Jiang">{{cite news |url=https://finance.sina.com.cn/tech/discovery/2023-01-01/doc-imxysvaz2402409.shtml |script-title=zh:著名物理化学家江龙逝世 |work=sina |date=1 January 2023 |access-date=2 January 2023 |language=zh}}</ref> He joined the [[Chinese Communist Party]] (CCP) in December 1949.<ref name="Jiang"/> In 1950, he was admitted to [[Nanjing University]], where he majored in the Department of Chemistry.<ref name="Jiang"/> After graduating in 1953, he was despatched to the Changchun Institute of Physical Chemistry, [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].<ref name="Jiang"/> In 1956, he was sent to study at the [[Academy of Sciences of the Soviet Union|Soviet Academy of Sciences]] on government scholarships, obtaining a vice-doctorate degree in 1960.<ref name="Jiang"/>

Jiang returned to China in 1960 and that same year became a member of the Institute of Chemistry, Chinese Academy of Sciences.<ref name="Jiang"/> He moved to the Institute of Photosensitivity, Chinese Academy of Sciences in 1970, where he was promoted to associate research fellow in 1979 and to research fellow in 1986.<ref name="Jiang"/> From December 1990 to June 1991, he was a visiting scholar at the [[Max Planck Institute of Biophysical Chemistry]] in Germany. He rose to become director of the Academic Committee of Key Laboratory of Colloids and Interfaces, Chinese Academy of Sciences in 1998.<ref name="Jiang"/>

Jiang died in [[Beijing]] on 31 December 2022, at the age of 89.<ref name="Jiang"/><ref>{{cite news |url=https://news.sciencenet.cn/htmlnews/2023/1/491972.shtm |script-title=zh:著名物理化学家江龙逝世 |work=sciencenet.cn |date=1 January 2023 |access-date=2 January 2023 |language=zh}}</ref>

==Honours and awards==
* 1999 Member of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS)
* 2008 Fellow of the [[Royal Society of Chemistry]] (RSC)
